title: Decade Dagger "Dragon's Restraint"

{{Weapon infobox | campaign = [[Core]] | type = [[daggers]] | image = [[Image:Decade Dagger "Dragon's Restraint".jpg|250px]]
[[:File:Dragon_Fangs.jpg|View weapon's in-game proportions]] | attribute = [[Dagger Mastery]] | damagetype = [[Slashing damage]] | unique = yes }} [[Decade Dagger "Dragon's Restraint"]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]]. ==Stats== :[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]]) :Deals 20% additional [[damage]] during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]]. :[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1 :Energy regeneration -1 :[[Expertise]]: 5 (if your rank is lower. No effect in PvP.) :{{Gray|Both hands}} :Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend. ==Skin== This item has the same appearance as [[Dragon Fangs]]. ==Replica== This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons. ==Notes== *These daggers leave behind a cutting trail of turquoise particles with each [[auto attack]] when the wielder is not under the effects of a [[form]] or [[tonic]]. *The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]). * Without attribute points invested in Expertise, the inherent Expertise from this weapon provides a 20% reduction to base Energy costs of [[attack skill|attack]], [[ritual]], [[touch skill|touch]], and [[Ranger skills]]. {{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, these daggers' appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}} ==Trivia== *Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|April 15, 2025 update]]. {{Decade weapons nav}} [[Category:Dagger Mastery unique items]] [[Category:Decade weapons|Daggers]] [[Category:Unreplicable unique items]]
